lists.title: Liisaska dooran
lists.description: Doorashooyinka foomka diiwaangelinta ardayga. Halkan mar ayaa lagu dejiyaa dhammaan madrasadaha, waxaadna u ogolaan kartaa madrasad inay isbeddesho liistooyinkeeda.
lists.platformDescription: Hal gelin sadar kasta. Madrasad kasta, oo uu ku jiro kuwa cusub, waxay isticmaashaa liisaskan haddii aadan u ogolaan kuwooda gaarka ah.
lists.saved: Liisaska waa la keydiyay dhammaan madrasadaha.
lists.failed: Liisaska lama keydin karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
lists.schoolsDescription: Dooro in madrasaddu isticmaasho liisaskan iyo in ay wax ka beddesho kuwooda. Madrasadda horey u beddeshay liisaskeeda hoos ayaa lagu calaamadeeyay.

toast.own: {name} hadda way wax ka beddeli kartaa liisaskeeda.
toast.failed: Tan lama beddeli karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.

platformKept.label: Liisaska guud
platformKept.hint: Waxay haysataa liisas gaar ah oo la keydiyay, dhinac la dhigay. Ogolow liisaska gaarka ah si loo soo celiyo.

ownEdited.label: Liisas gaar ah (la beddelay)
ownEdited.hint: Maamulaheeda ayaa beddelay liisaska. Waxaa la isticmaalaa halkii liisaska guud.

ownAllowed.label: Liisas gaar ah waa la ogolaaday
ownAllowed.hint: Maamulaheeda wuu beddeli karaa liisaska. Ilaa markaas waxay isticmaashaa liisaska guud.
